items.title: Griffin Gaming Partners, Entertainment 360 jointly unveil production company Hitpoint Entertainment
items.zh_title: Griffin Gaming Partners 与 Entertainment 360 联合成立制作公司 Hitpoint Entertainment
items.summary: A prominent game industry fund and Hollywood talent agency are teaming up to adapt games for TV and film.
items.zh_summary: 一家知名游戏产业基金与一家好莱坞经纪公司联手，要把游戏改编成影视作品。

items.title: Griffin Gaming Partners and Entertainment 360 launch new company to support video game adaptations for film and TV
items.zh_title: Griffin Gaming Partners 与 Entertainment 360 成立新公司，扶持游戏影视改编
items.summary: Griffin Gaming Partners has launched a new company to support game adaptations for film and television in partnership with talent management and production firm Entertainment 360. Read more
items.zh_summary: Griffin Gaming Partners 与人才管理及制作公司 Entertainment 360 合作，成立了一家新公司，专门扶持游戏改编电影和电视作品。

items.title: "Players want to engage with brands, not just consume them" – Mattel on its new Game Studios arm, why it's releasing on Roblox, and what it learnt from NetEase
items.zh_title: “玩家想参与品牌，而不只是消费品牌”——Mattel 谈新成立的 Game Studios、为何登陆 Roblox 以及从 NetEase 学到的东西
items.summary: In August, Mattel announced it was forming Mattel Game Studios , a new global development organisation with a focus on making games based on its own IP. Read more
items.zh_summary: 今年 8 月，Mattel 宣布成立 Mattel Game Studios，这是一个新的全球开发组织，专注于基于自有 IP 开发游戏。

items.title: Japan Actors Union announces guidelines addressing unauthorised use of generative AI to replicate voice performances
items.zh_title: 日本演员联盟出台准则，应对生成式 AI 未经授权复制配音表演
items.summary: The Japan Actors Union has announced new guidelines to address the unauthorised use of generative AI to replicate voice performances. Read more
items.zh_summary: 日本演员联盟发布了新准则，针对未经授权使用生成式 AI 复制配音表演的问题。

items.title: Sensor Tower data shows the yawning gap between GTA 6 and everything else
items.zh_title: Sensor Tower 数据：GTA 6 与其他游戏之间的差距大得惊人
items.summary: An analysis from Sensor Tower shows just how far ahead GTA 6 is in terms of preorders when compared with some of the biggest AAA games of the past six years. Read more
items.zh_summary: Sensor Tower 的分析显示，在预购量上，GTA 6 与过去六年里最大的几款 3A 游戏相比遥遥领先。

items.title: GDC Festival of Gaming 2027 moves to four-day format to "create a higher quality, more focused and valuable experience"
items.zh_title: GDC Festival of Gaming 2027 改为四天制，打造“更高质量、更聚焦、更有价值的体验”
items.summary: GDC Festival of Gaming will shift to a four-day format for its 2027 edition, taking place Monday through Thursday, March 1 to March 4. Read more
items.zh_summary: GDC Festival of Gaming 2027 年将改为四天制，于 3 月 1 日至 4 日周一到周四举行。

items.title: Accessibility basics: How to make your game more accessible
items.zh_title: 无障碍基础：如何让你的游戏更无障碍
items.summary: Learn the basics of video game accessibility: Where to begin, simple solutions for hearing, vision, motor, and cognitive needs, and why you should start early.
items.zh_summary: 学习游戏无障碍的基础知识：从哪里入手，针对听觉、视觉、肢体和认知需求的简单方案，以及为什么要尽早开始。

items.title: RocketWerkz' C# framework 'BRUTAL' is now available to all developers
items.zh_title: RocketWerkz 的 C# 框架 BRUTAL 现已向所有开发者开放
items.summary: Developers who want to complete control over their game's code have a new framework to lean on.
items.zh_summary: 想要完全掌控游戏代码的开发者，现在有了一个新的框架可用。

items.title: PEGI begins moving existing digital-only games with loot boxes up to a 16 rating
items.zh_title: PEGI 开始把含开箱的现有纯数字游戏上调至 16+ 分级
items.summary: Existing digital-only games that include paid random items, such as loot boxes, are being re-rated PEGI 16 if they currently carry a PEGI 3, 7, or 12 rating. Read more
items.zh_summary: 含付费随机道具（如开箱）的现有纯数字游戏，如果目前是 PEGI 3、7 或 12 级，将被重新评为 PEGI 16。

items.title: Moonlighter developer delays public playtest of next game over concerns of AI cloning
items.zh_title: 《Moonlighter》开发商因担心 AI 克隆而推迟新作公开测试
items.summary: Digital Sun Games is narrowing its early testing of ReVamp to its Discord community following fears of generative AI-enabled cloning.
items.zh_summary: 担心生成式 AI 导致克隆，Digital Sun Games 把新作《ReVamp》的早期测试收窄到 Discord 社区内进行。

items.title: Wizards of the Coast declines to voluntarily recognize D&D and Studio X union drive
items.zh_title: Wizards of the Coast 拒绝自愿承认《D&D》与 Studio X 团队的工会诉求
items.summary: Wizards of the Coast is refusing to grant voluntary recognition to a union drive by its Dungeons & Dragons and Studio X teams. Staff will instead vote on joining in a secret-ballot election overseen b…
items.zh_summary: Wizards of the Coast 拒绝自愿承认其《Dungeons & Dragons》和 Studio X 团队的工会诉求，员工将改为在官方监督下通过无记名投票决定是否加入工会。
